# `jsf_sir()`

Simulate an SIR epidemic model using JSF

## Usage

```r
jsf_sir(
  N = 1000,
  I0 = 10,
  beta = 0.5,
  gamma = 0.1,
  t_max = 60,
  dt = 0.1,
  switching_threshold_I = 10
)
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `N` | Total population size. |
| `I0` | Initial infectious population. |
| `beta` | Infection rate. |
| `gamma` | Recovery rate. |
| `t_max` | Final simulation time. |
| `dt` | Time step for the continuous/ODE part of JSF. |
| `switching_threshold_I` | Switching threshold for the infectious compartment. |

## Value

A data frame with columns `time`, `S`, `I`, and `R`.

## Description

This function runs a simple SIR epidemic model using the Python `jsf`
package through `reticulate`.

## Examples

```r
if (jsf_available()) {
  result <- jsf_sir(
    N = 1000,
    I0 = 10,
    beta = 0.5,
    gamma = 0.1,
    t_max = 1,
    dt = 0.1,
    switching_threshold_I = 10
  )

  head(result)
}
```
